title: Gooey Chocolate Orange Cake
description: Densely chocolaty and flourless, this cake uses three Terry's Chocolate Oranges, butter and eggs for a mousse-like, squidgy interior.
steps: Preheat the oven to 195°C/175°C fan. Grease and line a 23cm round cake tin.
Put 450g of the chocolate orange and all the butter in a heatproof bowl over boiling water. Heat until melted. Mix sparingly.
Break the eggs into a large bowl and whisk for at least 5 minutes until pale and fluffy — all the air comes from the eggs.
Allow the chocolate mixture to cool slightly, then slowly add the whisked egg a spoonful at a time, folding in gently.
Pour into the tin and bake for 40–45 minutes, or until the top is just set. Don't over-bake — you want it squidgy inside.
Allow to cool completely in the tin. Decorate with remaining chocolate orange segments.
notes: Serves 8–10. Tastes best slightly chilled. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days.
